narrative.market_view: Neutral-to-mild bullish. Overnight Taiwan futures were nearly flat despite mixed U.S. equities, while Nasdaq held positive and Micron delivered a strong earnings/guide signal for AI-memory demand. High long-end U.S. yields cap valuation expansion, so the preferred view is a modest positive open and range-to-firm session rather than a trend chase.
narrative.open_hypothesis: Expect a modest positive opening, centered near +55 bps versus the prior TAIEX close. The local futures basis is only mildly constructive, so do not extrapolate the prior day's strong move into another large gap.
narrative.intraday_hypothesis: Base case is range trading with positive semiconductor/memory rotation but repeated resistance near the 48,000 area. A sustained move requires heavyweight participation and breadth confirmation after 09:15-09:30.
narrative.close_hypothesis: Close modestly above the prior close, around +45 bps, if TSMC/electronics hold VWAP and non-electronic breadth does not reverse. High U.S. yields remain the main drag on a stronger trend-up close.
narrative.breadth_hypothesis: Breadth is expected mildly positive rather than purely heavyweight-led. The 9/30 V0 review showed broad non-electronic participation, so breadth prior is not mechanically reduced by high Treasury yields.
narrative.bull_script: Micron's earnings beat and strong outlook ignite memory/AI hardware, TSMC and electronics hold above opening range/VWAP, 48,000 is accepted, and non-electronics remain constructive. Session transitions from range to trend-up.
narrative.base_script: Small positive gap, early test of 48,000, then two-way trade. Semiconductor/memory strength offsets high-yield valuation pressure; index closes modestly green with positive but not extreme breadth.
narrative.bear_script: 48,000 rejects quickly, TSMC/electronics lose VWAP, and rising long-end yield concerns dominate the Micron catalyst. Breadth rolls negative and the market fades the opening, closing below the prior close.

key_drivers: TAIFEX night session closed 48,298, down 32 points (-0.07%), implying no large positive gap despite prior cash-market strength.
TSMC ADR slipped about 0.2%, limiting direct heavyweight gap support.
Nasdaq rose 0.24% while SOX was approximately flat; U.S. tech was more resilient than the broad market.
Micron beat fiscal Q4 expectations and guided above consensus, a positive catalyst for Taiwan memory/AI hardware chains.
U.S. 10-year Treasury yield near 5.29% remains a valuation headwind.
48,000 is the key nearby acceptance/rejection level after TAIEX closed 47,940.13.
invalidation_conditions: Opening gap materially exceeds +120 bps or opens negative beyond -50 bps, invalidating the expected modest-gap prior.
By 09:15-09:30, heavyweight electronics and TSMC are below VWAP/opening range with negative breadth: invalidate bullish close prior.
TAIEX accepts above 48,000 with expanding breadth and electronics leadership: upgrade range regime toward trend_up.
Memory/AI hardware fails to respond positively to Micron earnings and sector breadth turns negative: reduce bull scenario.
